params.body: Follow-up to #449 on the public proposal page (`/voorstel/{token}`). Shane on staging: "nog niet responsive" and "mss nog wat meer styling met de icoontjes". ## Icons - The page loads the app's own Font Awesome 5 (`public/template/icons/font-awesome/css/all.min.css`, the same file `layouts/modalApp` loads; the webfonts resolve next to it). No CDN. - "Kenmerken" uses the icons of the Stocklist card (`stocklist/_grid_card`): calendar for the year, road for the mileage, gas pump, cog, palette, tachometer for the power. Icon left of the label, `--brand-faint` ink. The icon travels with the fact from `ProposalPage::facts()`. - Phone and envelope on "Bel" and "Mail" (also on the expired page), a chat bubble on "Stel uw vraag over deze wagen", a small car in the accent colour next to "Een wagen voor u". ## Responsive Audited at 320, 390, 768, 1024, 1280 and 1440 (no element wider than the viewport at any of them, `scrollWidth == innerWidth`). Fixed: - facts grid was fixed at two columns on the narrowest phones: one column below 360px, two from 360px, three from 600px; - buttons take the full width below 640px and sit side by side above it; - long words (a dealer e-mail address, a package name) wrap with `overflow-wrap: anywhere` instead of pushing the card out; - the header logo no longer shrinks when the name is long; the main photo is capped at its frame. Already in place from #449 and verified: viewport meta, one column below 900px with the aside dissolved into reading order, horizontally scrolling thumbnails. ## Placeholder A vehicle without photos shows the app's `default_vehicle.png` (contained, on the field grey) instead of a broken ``. A photo that is on file but does not load (a file missing in the bucket) falls back to the same placeholder, also after tapping a thumbnail. ## Tests `ProposalPublicPageTest::test_the_page_carries_the_apps_icons_and_a_placeholder_for_a_missing_photo` covers the stylesheet, the icon classes per fact and button, the collapse rules, the placeholder with and without photos, and the expired page. Filter `Proposal|CompiledViews|StylesheetSyntax|RulesCoverage`: OK (36 tests, 928 assertions). Screenshots in `.playwright-mcp/proposal-polish/` (before-390, after-320/390/768/1024/1280/1440).
params.title: The proposal page fits every screen and carries the app's icons
